lines.en: label kirinfirsthall:
scene kirinhall1
: Yo.
: Please tell me you’re here for me. I’m bored as shit.
lines.zh: : 请告诉我你是来找我的。我无聊死了。

lines.en: : I was actually just about to text you begging you to come over.
lines.zh: : 我刚刚还真打算给你发短信求你过来呢。

lines.en: : I am here for you, Kirin.
lines.zh: : 我就是来找你的，Kirin。

lines.en: : Thank fucking God.
lines.zh: : 谢天谢地。

lines.en: : Noriko’s been blasting music for like two hours and I’m about to pour liquid cement into my ears.
lines.zh: : Noriko 放了快两个小时的音乐，我简直想把液体水泥灌进耳朵里。

lines.en: : I take it things aren’t going well in there?
lines.zh: : 看来里面的情况不太妙？

lines.en: : Oh, things are actually really great. Just kind of annoying at times.
lines.zh: : 哦，其实情况挺好的。只是有时候挺烦人。

lines.en: : But it’s not like I can tell her to chill when it’s her room, too. She can do whatever she wants.
lines.zh: : 可这也是她的房间，我总不能叫她消停点。她想干什么就干什么。

lines.en: : I’m sure there will be plenty of times where {i}she’ll{/i} get mad at me, so learning how to deal with that is a pretty logical first course of action.
lines.zh: : 我肯定以后会有很多次{i}她{/i}冲我发火，所以学着应付这件事是很合理的第一步。

lines.en: : Whatever the case, it sure beats staying at home.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，总比待在家里强。

lines.en: : Ramping up to complain about your sister again?
lines.zh: : 又要开始抱怨你姐姐了？

lines.en: scene kirinhall2
: What do you mean, “ramping up?”
lines.zh: : 什么叫“又要开始”？

lines.en: : You make it sound like that’s a thing I do all the time.
lines.zh: : 你说得好像这是我经常干的事一样。

lines.en: : I mean...not {i}all{/i} the time.
lines.zh: : 我是说……也不是{i}经常{/i}。

lines.en: : You’ve definitely made me aware of how much you hate living at home before, though.
lines.zh: : 不过你确实让我很清楚你有多讨厌住在家里。

lines.en: : But despite that, you still waited until you were put in my class to move into the dorms.
lines.zh: : 可尽管如此，你还是等到了被分进我班上才搬进宿舍。

lines.en: : Why didn't you just bite the bullet and move into the other building?
lines.zh: : 你为什么不干脆咬咬牙，直接搬进另一栋楼？

lines.en: scene kirinhall3
: Are you {i}trying{/i} to be a dick to me right now, or is this just happening on accident?
lines.zh: : 你现在是{i}存{/i}心想恶心我，还是不小心撞上的？

lines.en: : All I did was talk to you and now it’s like you’re fucking profiling me or something.
lines.zh: : 我只是跟你说了句话，现在倒弄得你像是在给我做侧写似的。

lines.en: : I didn’t mean it like that.
lines.zh: : 我不是那个意思。

lines.en: : I’m obviously glad you’re here. I wouldn’t have come to see you if I wasn’t.
lines.zh: : 我显然很高兴你在这儿。要不是，我也不会来看你。

lines.en: : I just...also like your sister and wouldn’t feel right if I didn’t at least try to stand up for her.
lines.zh: : 我只是……也喜欢你姐姐，如果不试着替她说两句话，我会过意不去。

lines.en: scene kirinhall4
: Well...yeah...that makes sense.
lines.zh: : 嗯……对……这倒说得通。

lines.en: : Sorry for being so on edge or whatever. I shouldn’t have exploded like that.
lines.zh: : 抱歉我这么一触即发什么的。我不该那样炸毛。

lines.en: : It’s just weird, you know?
lines.zh: : 只是很奇怪，你知道吗？

lines.en: : Even though I love it here, it’s still a huge frickin’ transition going from your parents’ house to living with some girl you literally just met.
lines.zh: : 虽然我很喜欢这里，但从父母家搬出来、跟一个你才刚认识的女孩住在一起，这个转变还是他妈的巨大。

lines.en: scene kirinhall5
: Buuuuut...that’s enough emotional Kirin for now. Help me take my mind off of that stuff, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 不——过——呢……感性的 Kirin 到此为止。帮我忘掉那些事吧，老师。

lines.en: : I’m sure you didn’t just come over here to hear me complain.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定你大老远过来不是为了听我抱怨。

lines.en: : If you want to complain, it’s fine-
lines.zh: : 如果你想抱怨，没关系的——

lines.en: : I {i}said{/i}...I’m sure you didn’t come all the way here to hear me complain.
lines.zh: : 我{i}说{/i}了……我敢肯定你大老远过来不是为了听我抱怨。

lines.en: : Take my fucking mind off stuff.
lines.zh: : 帮我他妈的忘掉那些事。

lines.en: : You can be really intimidating when you’re in a bad mood, Kirin.
lines.zh: : Kirin，你心情不好的时候真的挺吓人的。

lines.en: scene kirinhall6
: You just need to learn how to deal with me. Don’t call me intimidating just because you haven’t figured it out yet.
lines.zh: : 你只是需要学着怎么应付我。别因为你自己还没摸清门道就叫我吓人。

lines.en: if kirinpatgasm == True:
: Will more headpats do the trick? Because you seemed to {i}really{/i} like those.
lines.zh: : 那多摸摸头有用吗？你看起来{i}挺{/i}喜欢的。

lines.en: scene kirinhall7
: Wha-?! No?! That won’t do the trick at all!
lines.zh: : 什——？！不？！那一点用都没有！

lines.en: : I didn’t even like them that much!
lines.zh: : 我根本没有那么喜欢！

lines.en: : I distinctly remember you liking them so much that you started pleasuring yourself.
lines.zh: : 我清楚地记得你喜欢得都开始自我安慰了。

lines.en: : Shut up!
lines.zh: : 闭嘴！

lines.en: : I had to wash my sheets and everything.
lines.zh: : 我连床单都得洗，还有一堆事。

lines.en: scene kirinhall8
: OH MY GOD, STOP!
lines.zh: : 天哪，够了！

lines.en: else:
: Well, here’s hoping I’m actually able to do that one day.
lines.zh: : 嗯，希望有一天我真能做到。

lines.en: : If there’s anyone who can right now, it’s definitely you.
lines.zh: : 要说现在有谁能做到，那肯定是你。

lines.en: : Because I’m the first boy you’ve ever had feelings for?
lines.zh: : 因为我是你第一个动心的男生？

lines.en: scene kirinhall9
: There’s a difference between “having feelings” and “wanting to feel you inside of me.”
lines.zh: : “动心”和“想让你进来”是两回事。

lines.en: : Please don’t turn me on in the hallway.
lines.zh: : 别在走廊里把我弄兴奋。

lines.en: : I’d turn you on in the room but Noriko’s music would kill the mood for me.
lines.zh: : 我也想在房间里弄，可 Noriko 的音乐会让我瞬间没兴致。

lines.en: : You’re just going to have to hang in there, Sensei~
lines.zh: : 你只能先忍着了，老师～

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah...
lines.zh: : 是是是……

lines.en: : Anyway, have you been getting acclimated to life here apart from all of the Noriko stuff?
lines.zh: : 说起来，除了 Noriko 那堆事之外，你适应这里的生活了吗？

lines.en: : It must be a lot easier getting to[school] now, right?
lines.zh: : 现在去[school]肯定方便多了吧？

lines.en: scene kirinhall10
: I guess so, yeah.
lines.zh: : 大概吧，是啊。

lines.en: : Like, my parents’ house is far enough away for them to send buses and whatnot, but Karin and I never really took them.
lines.zh: : 比如，我父母家远到他们会安排校车什么的，但我和 Karin 从来都不怎么坐。

lines.en: : Is it because Karin thinks it’s best to get exercise early in the morning to...set your body up for the rest of the day or something?
lines.zh: : 是因为 Karin 觉得早上运动一下能……为一整天打下身体基础之类的？

lines.en: : I don’t know, probably. That sounds like a thing she would say.
lines.zh: : 我不知道，大概是吧。这听起来确实像她会说的话。

lines.en: : I just don’t really like buses. Or trains, really.
lines.zh: : 我只是真的不喜欢巴士。或者说火车也不喜欢。

lines.en: : Or any small space with a lot of people, I guess.
lines.zh: : 或者任何挤满了人的狭小空间，我想。

lines.en: : People suck. Why would I ever want to be surrounded by them?
lines.zh: : 人很讨厌。我为什么要让自己被他们围着？

lines.en: : It also means that there’s probably someone in that group who’s going to think {i}I{/i} suck as well.
lines.zh: : 而且那群人里大概还会有人觉得{i}我{/i}也很讨厌。

lines.en: : You do suck. And you’re quite good at it.
lines.zh: : 你确实很讨厌。而且你很擅长这一点。

lines.en: scene kirinhall11
: Yay. Blowjob compliment.
lines.zh: : 耶。口交式夸奖。

lines.en: : My parents would be so proud.
lines.zh: : 我父母一定会很骄傲的。

lines.en: scene kirinhall10
: But really, though. Fuck everybody.
lines.zh: : 不过说真的。去他妈的所有人。

lines.en: : I mean, if-
lines.zh: : 我是说，如——

lines.en: : Stop making sex jokes whenever I use a word that could also be considered suggestive.
lines.zh: : 别在我一用可能有暗示意味的词就开黄腔。

lines.en: : But that’s like, half of my strategy for keeping a conversation going.
lines.zh: : 可那几乎占了我维持对话的一半策略。

lines.en: : Are you sure it’s not half of your strategy for grooming [teenage]girls into thinking sex is cool and casual and that it would be totally fine to have it with you?
lines.zh: : 你确定那不是你一半的策略——用来诱导[teenage]女孩觉得性很酷、很随意、而且跟你发生关系完全没问题？

lines.en: : That does sound more in-line with how I think, yes.
lines.zh: : 这听起来更符合我的思维方式，是的。

lines.en: scene kirinhall1
: Well, hey. It’s definitely working, so it’s not like I can really bash you for it.
lines.zh: : 嗯，嘿。它确实奏效，所以我也真没法为此抨击你。

lines.en: : Right. You can just call me out on it and make me question my morals.
lines.zh: : 对。你大可以点破它，让我质疑自己的道德。

lines.en: : What morals?
lines.zh: : 什么道德？

lines.en: : See? Now I have to pretend to have them because you think I don’t.
lines.zh: : 看吧？现在因为你觉得我没有，我就得装作有。

lines.en: : Who needs morals when orgasms exist? Just do whatever you want as long as both parties consent.
lines.zh: : 既然有高潮存在，谁还需要道德？只要双方同意，想干什么就干什么。

lines.en: : Doesn’t matter if it’s teacher and student. Husband and mistress-
lines.zh: : 老师和学生也好。丈夫和情妇也好——

lines.en: : Uncle and niece.
lines.zh: : 叔叔和侄女。

lines.en: scene kirinhall12
: Do you...
: Do you want to fuck Ami?
lines.zh: : 你想操 Ami 吗？

lines.en: : I have no idea what you’re talking about.
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道你在说什么。

lines.en: : But...
lines.zh: : 可是……

lines.en: : But you just said-
lines.zh: : 可你刚才说——

lines.en: : Well, it’s been fun, Kirin. But it’s probably time for me to start heading back.
lines.zh: : 好了，今天聊得挺开心，Kirin。不过我也该回去了。

lines.en: : I’m gonna...go ahead and forget I heard that.
lines.zh: : 我打、打算……当我没听见。

lines.en: : Again, no idea what you’re talking about.
lines.zh: : 再说一次，我不知道你在说什么。

lines.en: scene black
Kirin sighs and presses her back up against her door.
lines.zh: Kirin 叹了口气，背靠在门上。

lines.en: We talk for a short while after that, but the conversation loses steam and we ultimately wind up a little bored further down the line.
lines.zh: 之后我们又聊了一会儿，但对话渐渐没了劲头，最后两个人都觉得有点无聊。

lines.en: I think about inviting her out to walk around town or something, but it’s already getting really late and it would make more sense at this point to just go home.
lines.zh: 我想约她出去在镇上走走什么的，可天已经很晚了，这个时候还是直接回家更合理。

lines.en: In the end, we exchange goodbyes and head our separate ways.
lines.zh: 最后我们道了别，各走各的路。

lines.en: I can hear another sigh from Kirin bleed into the sounds of rock music contaminating the hall once she opens the door.
lines.zh: Kirin 一开门，我又听见她的一声叹息混进了污染走廊的摇滚乐里。

lines.en: Here’s hoping she can get some sleep tonight.
lines.zh: 希望她今晚能睡个好觉。
